🚧 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐟𝐟𝐢𝐜 𝐀𝐝𝐯𝐢𝐬𝐨𝐫𝐲  🚧

Miami-Dade Water and Sewer crews will replace an out-of-service fire hydrant near 7836 NW 6 Ct starting at 9 p.m. on Thursday, Feb. 5.

To accommodate this work, one westbound lane on NW 79th St and one southbound lane on NW 6th Ct toward the I-95 South entrance will temporarily be merged.

⏳ Work is expected to be completed within 8 hours.
@MiamiDadeWater
